boards.title: Your First Weekend at Grand Valley State University, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A practical, under-21-safe first pass through named Allendale Campus places: orient yourself, find study and creative spaces, then sample recreation and campus dining.

cards.title: Start at the Kirkhof Center
cards.subtitle: Friday arrival · Allendale Campus
cards.notes: Use the information desk to get oriented, then look through the building’s lounges, game room, movie theatre, event spaces, and dining areas.
cards.short_summary: A central indoor starting point for getting acquainted with campus.
cards.evidence_claim: GVSU identifies the Russell H. Kirkhof Center as the social heart of the Allendale campus and lists study lounges, event spaces, a game room, movie theatre, and dining options.
cards.access_notes: The university calendar lists the address as 10670 S Campus Dr. Check building access and posted hours before going.

cards.title: Meet beneath the Cook Carillon Tower
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · near the library
cards.notes: Choose the tower as a clear campus rendezvous point, then pause to look up at the bell tower before continuing toward the library and plaza.
cards.short_summary: A recognizable outdoor landmark for a first campus meetup.
cards.evidence_claim: GVSU states that the Cook Carillon Tower was built in 1994 and contains 48 bronze bells.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor landmark; use normal campus pathways and follow any event-area reservations or instructions.

cards.title: Settle into Mary Idema Pew Library
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · 1 Campus Drive
cards.notes: Find a study space, locate the IT Help Desk, and make a quick pass through the Digital Creator Lab or Technology Showcase while the library is open.
cards.short_summary: A first stop for study space, campus support, and creative technology.
cards.evidence_claim: The Mary Idema Pew Library provides study spaces, the Knowledge Market, Digital Creator Lab, Technology Showcase, and an IT Help Desk on the Allendale Campus.
cards.access_notes: Study spaces are available whenever the library is open. Confirm current library hours before visiting.

cards.title: See what is on view at PAC Gallery
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · Haas Center for Performing Arts
cards.notes: Walk to Room 1121 in the Haas Center and check the current exhibition page before you go, since the gallery closes between exhibitions and semesters.
cards.short_summary: A compact art stop inside the performing-arts center.
cards.evidence_claim: GVSU’s PAC Gallery is in Room 1121 of the Thomas J. and Marcia J. Haas Center for Performing Arts on the Allendale Campus.
cards.access_notes: Listed regular hours are Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday and Friday 10 a.m.–5 p.m., and Thursday 10 a.m.–7 p.m., during fall and winter terms.

cards.title: Grab dinner in Kirkhof
cards.subtitle: Friday evening · Russell H. Kirkhof Center
cards.notes: Pick a counter that fits your meal, then keep the receipt or dining plan ready; the current campus food map lists several named Kirkhof options.
cards.short_summary: An on-campus dinner stop with multiple counter-service choices.
cards.evidence_claim: GVSU’s Allendale food map lists Lobby Shop, Freshens, Panda Express, Qdoba, Erbert & Gerbert’s, Ciao, and Laker Grill in Kirkhof.
cards.access_notes: Food purchases are required. Check each operator’s current hours and availability before heading over.

cards.title: Try an open climb session
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon · Fieldhouse B170
cards.notes: Review the climbing center schedule, arrive during an open-climb window, and ask staff which activities and equipment are appropriate for a first visit.
cards.short_summary: A supervised indoor recreation option in the Fieldhouse.
cards.evidence_claim: GVSU’s Climbing Center is located in B170 of the Fieldhouse and offers open climb alongside workshops, classes, clubs, and private events.
cards.access_notes: The published fall/winter schedule includes Saturday open climb from 1–5 p.m.; schedules change, so confirm the current page before travel.

cards.title: Take a daylight arboretum walk
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon · Allendale Campus
cards.notes: Walk the campus grounds in daylight and use the arboretum as a slower reset between indoor stops; stay on maintained paths and respect closures.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor campus walk among a documented tree collection.
cards.evidence_claim: GVSU reports that its Allendale Campus Arboretum covers seven acres and contains 700 trees representing 200 species or varieties.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor grounds access can be affected by weather, maintenance, and campus operations; follow posted guidance.

cards.entity_name: Seidman House and Lemmen Library & Archives
cards.title: Plan a future archives visit at Seidman House
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon · Great Lakes Academic Buildings Plaza
cards.notes: Locate Seidman House beside Lake Superior Hall, then email ahead if you want to use archival materials rather than expecting a walk-in research session.
cards.short_summary: A historic campus house containing special collections and archives.
cards.evidence_claim: Lemmen Library & Archives is inside Seidman House on the Allendale Campus, east of Lake Superior Hall, and requests on-site research appointments by email.
cards.access_notes: An on-site research appointment is requested for collections use. Visitors need a temporary permit in non-metered parking areas.

cards.title: Check the Transformational Link gathering space
cards.subtitle: Saturday evening · designated campus public forum
cards.notes: If a student-organized public gathering is underway, observe or participate respectfully; do not block routes, and check whether the space has been reserved.
cards.short_summary: A designated outdoor setting for student expression and gathering.
cards.evidence_claim: GVSU designates the Transformational Link as a location for expressive activity, including student meetings, performances, demonstrations, rallies, and vigils, and states there is no cost for expressive activity there.
cards.access_notes: A reservation takes precedence over spontaneous activity. Follow the university’s grounds and facility-use rules and keep activity within the designated area.

cards.title: Book an equipment orientation
cards.subtitle: Sunday planning stop · Recreation Center
cards.notes: Use the Fitness & Wellness page to request help learning the Recreation Center equipment, then schedule around the program’s current availability.
cards.short_summary: A practical way to make the Recreation Center less intimidating next week.
cards.evidence_claim: GVSU Fitness & Wellness lists equipment orientations for people seeking help navigating equipment available at the Recreation Center.
cards.access_notes: Fitness Services is in the Recreation Center at 1 Campus Drive; the page says training services are available by appointment.
